name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix closed at a new all-time high of ₩2,425,000 on the June 17 KOSPI session — surpassing the prior ATH of ₩2,407,000 set June 2, gaining +4.21% on above-average volume. The KRX session closed at 06:30 UTC, hours before Warsh's 2:00 PM ET FOMC announcement. The FOMC outcome that evening was the hawkish scenario flagged in this morning's brief: 9 of 18 members project 2026 rate hikes, the median year-end dot rose to 3.8%, PCE inflation forecast raised to 3.6%, and Warsh dropped forward guidance entirely. The KRW is now under meaningful pressure — DXY is estimated to have crossed 100 post-FOMC, pushing USD/KRW from ~₩1,512 toward ₩1,530–₩1,545 — and the ~54% foreign-owned float will feel the FX headwind on tomorrow's June 18 KOSPI open. However, the ATH close at ₩2,425,000 is confirmed, the fundamental story (HBM4 shortage until 2028, NVIDIA supply lock through 2030, record 72% Q1 operating margin) is intact, and the hawkish scenario pre-positioned the ₩2,350,000–₩2,380,000 zone as the add window if the FOMC materialized as it did. The decision is downgraded from BUY HIGH to BUY MEDIUM: the ATH breakout conviction is sustained; the FX headwind dampens the near-term multiple.

decision.rationale: BUY at MEDIUM conviction (downgraded from HIGH). The ATH break at ₩2,425,000 on above-average volume is confirmed — the core long thesis is intact. The hawkish FOMC scenario materialized as feared (9/18 members favor hikes, dot median 3.8%, Warsh dropped guidance), creating a real FX headwind: USD/KRW is estimated to have risen from ₩1,512 to ₩1,530–₩1,545, which directly compresses dollar-denominated returns for the ~54% foreign-owned float. Conviction downgrade from HIGH to MEDIUM reflects this FX headwind, not any fundamental change in the HBM story. Sizing guidance: hold the core long; use the FOMC-driven pullback to ₩2,350,000–₩2,380,000 (hawkish-scenario add window) as the entry for the next tranche if tomorrow's June 18 KOSPI session opens lower on the FOMC reaction. Drift stops to ₩2,280,000–₩2,300,000. The prior ATH at ₩2,407,000 is the critical structural support — a close below it on above-average volume would require reassessment. Critically: Warsh said he 'can't give guidance on what we're going to do next' — the hawkish dots are aspirational, not committed; the KRW headwind may be less durable than the initial spike suggests.

analysis:
## ATH confirmed — and then the FOMC arrived

SK Hynix printed **₩2,425,000** on the June 17 KOSPI session (KRX closed 06:30 UTC), confirming a new all-time high on above-average volume. The session closed at the exact high of the day — one of the most bullish possible technical prints, signaling that sellers never showed up to defend the ATH intraday. Then, hours later, Warsh delivered the hawkish FOMC outcome the morning brief warned about. The two events now exist in sequence: the ATH is a fact; the FOMC is a near-term headwind. Understanding how to hold both of these simultaneously is the whole trade.

## Technical analysis

**Trend:** SK Hynix is in a primary uptrend on every meaningful timeframe. The stock has rallied +272% YTD, broke to a new ATH today, and has made higher highs and higher lows since the June 12 low at ₩2,048,000. There is no trend reversal signal; the FOMC creates a potential near-term pullback, not a regime change.

**Momentum:** Strongly bullish (+4.21% on the session), though the FOMC hawkish surprise will pressure the opening momentum for tomorrow's June 18 KOSPI session. The five-session advance of +18.4% from the June 12 low is extended in the short term — a consolidation or pullback is healthy and expected after a vertical move.

**Volume:** **5.3M shares vs ~4.1M average** — above average by ~29%. This is the critical confirmation: ATH breakouts on above-average volume are the most reliable continuation signals in technical analysis. A breakout on thin volume (below the 20-day average) is suspect; this is a conviction-backed move.

**Pattern:** The prior ATH at ₩2,407,000 acted as resistance for four weeks (May 21 – June 16). Today's clean break of that resistance on above-average volume is a textbook 'resistance becomes support' setup. The next test is whether the June 18 KOSPI session — which will price in the hawkish FOMC — respects ₩2,407,000 as the new floor.

**★ Strongest support — ₩2,407,000 prior ATH:** This level was the ceiling for four weeks and was tested multiple times before today's clean break. Once broken on above-average volume, the prior resistance becomes the strongest support, because all the buyers who were frustrated at this ceiling are now long above it — they will defend it aggressively to protect their basis. A close back below ₩2,407,000 on above-average volume is the only signal that would change the ATH-breakout read.

**★ Strongest resistance — ₩2,425,000 new ATH:** By definition, every future rally must exceed today's close to make new highs. There is no overhead supply above ₩2,425,000 (no one is sitting on losses from paying more). The first resistance above is the analyst consensus targets: ₩2,520,000 (median PT) and ₩2,690,000 (average PT across 38 analysts).

**Volume divergence note:** Today's below-average-volume comparison is reversed vs NVDA: SK Hynix printed ABOVE average on a bullish ATH day, while NVDA printed BELOW average on a down day. The divergence is significant: the bulls in SK Hynix are showing conviction; the bears in NVDA are not. These are both constructive signals in their respective directions.

**Decision point for June 18:** ₩2,407,000 — the level that either holds as the new floor (confirming the ATH breakout) or fails (sending the stock back into the prior ATH zone and requiring re-entry patience).

## The FOMC hawkish scenario and what it means for June 18

The [hawkish scenario materialized](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/17/fed-interest-rate-decision-june-2026.html) — 9 of 18 members project hikes, dot median 3.8%, inflation forecast raised to 3.6%. DXY is estimated to have crossed 100 post-FOMC, pushing USD/KRW from ~₩1,512 toward ₩1,530–₩1,545. For SK Hynix's ~54% foreign float, this means dollar-denominated returns from the ATH close of ₩2,425,000 are being compressed by ~2–4% on the FX move alone.

But Warsh dropped forward guidance: he 'can't give guidance on what we're going to do next.' The hawkish dots are what 18 people think today — not a commitment from the chairman. A single CPI print that comes in soft reverses the dollar rally and brings the KRW back toward ₩1,512. The FX headwind is real; it is not necessarily durable.

For the June 18 KOSPI open (00:00 UTC): the **₩2,350,000–₩2,380,000 add window** that the morning brief pre-positioned for the hawkish scenario is now the first actionable level. If the stock opens in this range on the FOMC reaction, the decision framework is: add with confirmation (above-average buying volume by 10:00 KST), hold into the ₩2,690,000 analyst average PT, stop at ₩2,280,000 daily close.
